draft.emotion: casual and practical, getting dressed to go outside
notes: Jasje is the diminutive form of jas (coat), but it is commonly used on its own to refer to a standard jacket or a blazer.
Do not confuse it with a heavy winter coat; jasje implies a lighter outer garment.

senses.definition: A short coat worn as outer clothing.
